title: Future AGI Helm chart values
description: Generated from values.yaml by hack/values_docs.py; edit values.yaml or the rules there.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the resource name prefix. Default: the release name, plus "-futureagi" unless the release name already contains it.

imageRegistry.description: Registry that replaces every image's own, Future AGI and third-party alike (docker.io, and ghcr.io for the bundled MinIO): a mirror holding every image `hack/list-images.sh` lists, e.g. `registry.example.com/futureagi-mirror`. Not a pull-through cache of one upstream: for Docker Hub alone set `image.registry` and each Docker Hub `<datastore>.bundled.image.registry` to it instead, and leave `objectStorage.bundled.image.registry` on ghcr.io (or a ghcr.io cache). Empty keeps each image's own registry.

imagePullSecrets.description: Pull secrets added to every pod, e.g. `[{name: regcred}]`.

storageClass.description: StorageClass of every PersistentVolumeClaim the chart creates. Empty uses the cluster default. Install-time only for the bundled datastores (see "Install-time settings" in README.md).

airgap.description: Air-gapped install: turns off the platform's own calls to the internet. Turns telemetry off [FUTURE_AGI_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=true] (one minimal registration attempt remains; offline it fails harmlessly and is retried), the license heartbeat off unless `license.heartbeat` is `true` [FUTURE_AGI_ENTERPRISE_HEARTBEAT_DISABLED=true], sets [LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True] on the Python pods and serving, and [HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1] on serving, whose models must then be pre-seeded on `serving.persistence` (examples/airgap.yaml). Mirror the images first (`hack/list-images.sh`) and set `global.imageRegistry` and `global.imagePullSecrets`.

noProxy.description: [NO_PROXY, no_proxy] extra hosts, domains or CIDRs that bypass the proxy, comma-separated. The chart always adds localhost, 127.0.0.1, the release's Services, `.<namespace>`, `.svc`, `.cluster.local` and the PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis and Temporal hosts; add an external object-storage endpoint here when it is reachable without the proxy (MinIO in your network, an S3 VPC endpoint). Object storage requests match against the host they go to: with `objectStorage.external.endpoint` empty (AWS S3), that is `<bucket>.s3.<region>.amazonaws.com`, so list `.s3.<region>.amazonaws.com`, not `s3.amazonaws.com`. Set only with `httpProxy` or `httpsProxy`.

configMap.description: ConfigMap holding the PEM bundle. Use `configMap` or `secret`, not both.

key.description: Key of the PEM bundle in the ConfigMap or Secret. It must contain every CA the pods need, public roots included when the pods also reach the internet: it replaces the image's trust store [SSL_CERT_FILE, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE, CURL_CA_BUNDLE, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS; PGSSLROOTCERT when `postgres.external.sslMode` is verify-ca or verify-full].

adaptSecurityContext.description: `auto`: on OpenShift (the security.openshift.io/v1 API exists) leave runAsUser, runAsGroup, fsGroup and seccompProfile out of every pod and container security context, so the restricted-v2 SCC assigns them. `force`: always. `disabled`: never.

registry.description: Registry of the Future AGI images.

tag.description: Tag of every Future AGI image (backend, workers, frontend, fi-collector, agentcc-gateway, serving, code-executor). Empty uses the chart's appVersion. A component's own `image.tag` wins.

pullPolicy.description: Pull policy of every image unless a component sets its own.

pinDigests.description: Pin each Future AGI image to the digest in `image.digests`, but only while its tag is the chart's appVersion and its repository path the published one: `--set image.tag=...` or another repository path runs that image by tag. Another registry (`image.registry`, `global.imageRegistry`) keeps the digest, which suits a mirror that copies the images with `crane copy` or `oras copy -r` (they keep the digests). Set `false` for a mirror that re-pushes images, or for your own build under the same repository path (or give that component its own `image.digest`): the published digest does not exist there and the pull fails. The bundled PostgreSQL, Redis and MinIO images are pinned the same way, on their default tags only.

digests.description: Digests (`sha256:...`) of the release's images, by component: backend (also the workers and the bootstrap job), frontend, fiCollector, agentccGateway, serving, codeExecutor. Empty in git; the published chart carries the digests of its own release. A component's own `image.digest` wins.

app.description: Public URL of the UI, e.g. `https://futureagi.example.com` [FRONTEND_URL, APP_URL, EXTRA_CSRF_ORIGINS]. Invite and password-reset links and app emails point here, with its scheme. Empty: derived from `ingress.app.host` with `ingress.enabled`, else from `gatewayApi.app.host` with `gatewayApi.enabled` (https unless `gatewayApi.tls` is false), else `http://localhost:3000`.

api.description: Public URL of the API, e.g. `https://api.futureagi.example.com` [BASE_URL, and the UI's VITE_HOST_API]. Empty: derived from `ingress.api.host` with `ingress.enabled`, else from `gatewayApi.api.host` with `gatewayApi.enabled`, else `http://localhost:8000`.

otlp.description: [FI_COLLECTOR_PUBLIC_URL] Public OTLP/HTTP base URL of fi-collector, e.g. `https://otlp.example.com`: what SDKs outside the cluster set as FI_BASE_URL, shown in the install notes, the in-app SDK snippet and the setup screen. Set it when the collector is exposed another way (e.g. `fiCollector.service.type=LoadBalancer`). Empty: derived from `ingress.otlp` with `ingress.enabled`, else from `gatewayApi.otlp` with `gatewayApi.enabled`, else `http://localhost:4318` (the port-forward in the install notes).

objects.description: Public URL browsers download stored files from [MINIO_URL]; used when `objectStorage.backend` is `minio`. Empty: derived from `ingress.objects.host` with `ingress.enabled`, else the external endpoint, else `http://localhost:<objectStorage.bundled.service.downloadPort>` (9005).

envType.description: [ENV_TYPE] `production`: JSON logs, DEBUG off, refuses published default secrets. `local`: colored console logs.

logLevel.description: [LOG_LEVEL] of the backend, workers and bootstrap job.

allowedHosts.description: [ALLOWED_HOSTS], comma-separated. `*` accepts any Host header. A list also gets localhost and the in-cluster service names, which the probes and the workers use, and the pod's own IP (`$(POD_IP)`), which load balancers that health-check pods directly send as the Host. Empty: the API host once the API has a public URL (`urls.api`, `gatewayApi.api.host` or `ingress.api.host`), else `*`.

corsAllowedOrigins.description: [CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS] browser origins allowed to call the API with credentials, comma-separated. `*`: every origin. Empty: the UI's origin plus `extraCsrfOrigins` once the UI has a public URL (`urls.app`, `gatewayApi.app.host` or `ingress.app.host`), else every origin.

extraCsrfOrigins.description: [EXTRA_CSRF_ORIGINS] in addition to the UI URL, comma-separated.

telemetry.description: Deployment telemetry: an instance id, the version, admin emails and usage counts every 6 hours, never traces, prompts or other content. `false` sets FUTURE_AGI_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=true (one minimal ping remains).

recaptcha.description: [RECAPTCHA_ENABLED] reCAPTCHA on sign-up, login and token refresh, for every Host but localhost. Needs `secrets.extra.RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY` (without it every such login is refused) and a frontend image built with VITE_GOOGLE_SITE_KEY (a build-time setting: the published image has none, so its logins fail).

otel.description: [OTEL_ENABLED] export the platform's own traces over OpenTelemetry (configure OTEL_* in `config.extraEnv`).

usageEvents.description: [USAGE_EVENTS_ENABLED] billing usage events on the Redis stream usage:events, from the backend, workers and fi-collector. Only for installs that run the usage consumer (Future AGI Cloud): anywhere else nothing drains the stream and it fills Redis.

cdcMode.description: [FI_CDC_MODE] Postgres to ClickHouse change data capture. `outbox`: triggers plus a drain in the Temporal workers (no PeerDB). `off` removes it (Observe views then miss relational data).

mailgunSenderDomain.description: [MAILGUN_SENDER_DOMAIN]. Email stays off until `secrets.mailgunApiKey` is set too; invites then return a link to share yourself.

fromEmail.description: [DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL] sender of every app email (invites, password resets). Empty: `Future AGI <noreply@<mailgunSenderDomain>>`.

replyTo.description: [DEFAULT_REPLY_TO_EMAIL] Reply-To of app emails. Empty: no Reply-To header, so replies go to the sender.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret with the Mailgun API key [MAILGUN_API_KEY] (wins over `secrets.mailgunApiKey`).

existingSecretKey.description: Key of the Mailgun API key in `existingSecret`.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the backend, workers and bootstrap job, as `NAME: value`. Every supported key: https://docs.futureagi.com/docs/self-hosting/configuration/reference (rows marked H).

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra `envFrom` sources for the backend, workers and bootstrap job, e.g. `[{secretRef: {name: my-env}}]`.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret with the application keys: SECRET_KEY, INTEGRATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY, AGENTCC_INTERNAL_API_KEY, AGENTCC_ADMIN_TOKEN, PROPERTY_CATALOG_API_PASSWORD, PROPERTY_CATALOG_CONSUMER_PASSWORD and AGENTCC_WEBHOOK_SECRET (unless `agentccWebhookSecret` is set). Empty: generated. Required with Argo CD, which cannot `lookup` the generated Secret.
Existing Secret with any of OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (missing keys are fine). Overrides the values below.

openaiApiKey.description: [OPENAI_API_KEY] server-wide key for built-in evals and the gateway. Workspaces can also add their own in the UI.

googleApiKey.description: [GOOGLE_API_KEY] Gemini (Google AI Studio); the gateway gets it as GEMINI_API_KEY.

eeLicenseKey.description: Deprecated: use `license.key` or `license.existingSecret`. [EE_LICENSE_KEY] Enterprise Edition license, still honoured when `license.*` is empty.

agentccWebhookSecret.description: [AGENTCC_WEBHOOK_SECRET] shared secret the gateway sends its request logs to the backend with. Empty: read from `existingSecret` when that is set, else generated.

extra.description: Any other secret environment variables for the backend, workers and bootstrap job, as `NAME: value` (e.g. SENTRY_DSN, DAYTONA_API_KEY). Stored in <fullname>-secrets.

edition.description: `oss` or `ee`. `ee` requires a license (`license.key` or `license.existingSecret`) and shows the license and SSO settings in the install notes. It never changes the image.

key.description: [EE_LICENSE_KEY] Enterprise license key, stored in <fullname>-secrets. Prefer `existingSecret`. Setting a license also turns on the Enterprise apps, whose migrations the bootstrap job runs.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret with the license key (wins over `key`). The backend, the workers and the bootstrap job read it.

url.description: [FUTURE_AGI_LICENSE_URL] license activation and heartbeat server. Empty: the application default (Future AGI's license service).

heartbeat.description: License heartbeat [FUTURE_AGI_ENTERPRISE_HEARTBEAT_DISABLED, inverted]. Empty (null): on, off with `global.airgap`. `true` or `false` wins.

publicKey.description: [EE_LICENSE_PUBLIC_KEY] PEM public key that verifies the license. Honoured only by images without a built-in license key (pre-GA builds); leave empty unless Future AGI gave you one.

clockSkewSeconds.description: [EE_LICENSE_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS] tolerance when checking the license's validity window; set only while a license is configured.

clientId.description: [AUTH0_CLIENT_ID] OAuth client ID of a Google Cloud "Web application" client (the app names Google's settings AUTH0_*).

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret with the client ID and secret (wins over the values above).

clientIdKey.description: Key of the client ID in `existingSecret`.

clientSecretKey.description: Key of the client secret in `existingSecret`.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret with the client ID and secret (wins over the values above).

clientIdKey.description: Key of the client ID in `existingSecret`.

clientSecretKey.description: Key of the client secret in `existingSecret`.

clientId.description: [MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID] of a Microsoft Entra app registration (multi-tenant: the app signs in through the `common` endpoint).

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret with the client ID and secret (wins over the values above).

clientIdKey.description: Key of the client ID in `existingSecret`.

clientSecretKey.description: Key of the client secret in `existingSecret`.

enabled.description: Render the ExternalSecrets below (needs the External Secrets Operator and its CRDs).

apiVersion.description: API version of the ExternalSecret objects.

secretStoreRef.description: SecretStore or ClusterSecretStore every ExternalSecret reads from, e.g. `{name: vault, kind: ClusterSecretStore}`. An entry's own `secretStoreRef` wins.

refreshInterval.description: How often the operator re-reads the store.

secrets.description: One ExternalSecret per entry, as `<group>: {data: {<SECRET_KEY>: {key, property}}, dataFrom: [...], secretStoreRef: {...}}`. Groups and the Secret each creates: `app` (secrets.existingSecret), `llm` (secrets.llm.existingSecret), `license` (license.existingSecret), `email` (config.email.existingSecret), `google`, `github`, `microsoft` (auth.*.existingSecret), `admin` (bootstrap.admin.existingSecret), `postgres`, `clickhouse`, `redis`, `objectStorage` (<store>.existingSecret). That existingSecret value must be set. See examples/external-secrets.yaml.

enabled.description: Add `reloader.annotations` to every Future AGI Deployment (needs Stakater Reloader, or a tool that reads the same annotations).

annotations.description: Annotations added to the Deployments' metadata.

password.description: [PG_PASSWORD]. External: required unless `existingSecret`. Bundled: empty generates one.

host.description: [PG_HOST] PostgreSQL 16 server (11 or newer works), reached directly: the outbox CDC holds a session advisory lock and migrations set session options. Put a pooler in `postgres.pooler`, not here.

sslMode.description: [PGSSLMODE] disable, allow, prefer, require, verify-ca or verify-full. verify-ca and verify-full need the server's CA: mount it with `backend`, `worker`, `bootstrap` and `fiCollector` `extraVolumes`/`extraVolumeMounts`, and point PGSSLROOTCERT at it in `config.extraEnv` and `fiCollector.extraEnv`.

enabled.description: Send the backend's and workers' Django connections through a transaction-mode pooler such as PgBouncer [PGBOUNCER_HOST, PGBOUNCER_PORT], for many API and worker pods. `PG_HOST` stays the direct server (outbox CDC, migrations), and the bootstrap job always connects directly [PG_DIRECT_HOST]. PgBouncer settings the app needs: `pool_mode = transaction`, `server_reset_query_always = 1`, `ignore_startup_parameters = extra_float_digits,search_path`.

Register a read replica (or a pooler in front of one) for the backend and workers [PGBOUNCER_READ_HOST, PGBOUNCER_READ_PORT, PG_READ_DB]. Only the models and features in `optIn` read from it; everything else stays on the primary.

host.description: [PGBOUNCER_READ_HOST] host of the replica, or of its pooler. Same user and password as the primary.

optIn.description: [READ_REPLICA_OPT_IN] model class names (e.g. `Dashboard`) and `feature:` keys routed to the replica. Empty: nothing reads from it.

registry.description: Registry of the bundled PostgreSQL image.

repository.description: Repository of the bundled PostgreSQL image. Debian-based, like the compose setups, so data directories are interchangeable.

tag.description: Tag of the bundled PostgreSQL image: an exact 16.x release on Debian (the compose setups run `postgres:16`, also Debian).

digest.description: Digest pinned after the tag; wins over the chart's own pin. Empty: the default tag above runs pinned to the digest the chart was tested with (while `image.pinDigests` is on), and any other tag or repository runs by tag.

size.description: Size of the data volume. Install-time only (see "Install-time settings" in README.md).

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the data volume. Empty: `global.storageClass`, else the cluster default. Install-time only.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the bundled PostgreSQL. Empty: the top-level `nodeSelector`.

tolerations.description: Tolerations of the bundled PostgreSQL. Empty: the top-level `tolerations`.

affinity.description: Affinity of the bundled PostgreSQL. Empty: the top-level `affinity`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod securityContext merged over the chart's (runAsNonRoot, the image's user and group, fsGroup, RuntimeDefault seccomp). `global.compatibility.openshift.adaptSecurityContext` drops the fixed IDs.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext merged over the chart's (no privilege escalation, all capabilities dropped).

database.description: [CH_DATABASE, CH25_DATABASE] database of traces and analytics.

user.description: [CH_USERNAME] needs CREATE on the database; the bootstrap also creates the observed-attribute index (CREATE DATABASE, CREATE USER, GRANT) unless `bootstrap.propertyCatalog` is false. Bundled: `default`, the bundled server's only user.

password.description: [CH_PASSWORD]. External: may be empty. Bundled: empty generates one.

propertyCatalogDatabase.description: [PROPERTY_CATALOG_DATABASE] database of the observed-attribute index; must differ from `database`.

host.description: [CH_HOST] ClickHouse host. Plain HTTP and native protocol: the schema installer and fi-collector do not speak TLS to ClickHouse.

registry.description: Registry of the bundled ClickHouse image.

repository.description: Repository of the bundled ClickHouse image.

tag.description: Tag of the bundled ClickHouse image. 25.3 is the floor for the v2 spans schema.

digest.description: Optional digest (`sha256:...`) pinned after the tag.

lowMemory.description: Small caches and merge pools and no system log tables (deploy/standalone/clickhouse), as in the Standalone install. Turn off on nodes with 8 GiB or more for ClickHouse.

size.description: Size of the data volume. Install-time only (see "Install-time settings" in README.md).

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the data volume. Empty: `global.storageClass`, else the cluster default. Install-time only.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the bundled ClickHouse. Empty: the top-level `nodeSelector`.

tolerations.description: Tolerations of the bundled ClickHouse. Empty: the top-level `tolerations`.

affinity.description: Affinity of the bundled ClickHouse. Empty: the top-level `affinity`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod securityContext merged over the chart's (runAsNonRoot, the image's user and group, fsGroup, RuntimeDefault seccomp). `global.compatibility.openshift.adaptSecurityContext` drops the fixed IDs.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext merged over the chart's (no privilege escalation, all capabilities dropped).

mode.description: `external` or `bundled`. Cache, locks and the live-update channel layer.

password.description: [REDIS_PASSWORD] Must be URL-safe (letters, digits, `-._~`): it is part of the Redis URLs. External: empty means no AUTH. Bundled: empty generates one.

host.description: [REDIS_HOST] Redis 6 or newer with databases 0-4 (the app uses 0 to 3; the LLM gateway 4, see `agentccGateway.redis`).

tls.description: Connect the app over TLS (`rediss://`). fi-collector has no Redis TLS: with TLS on it runs without Redis (key revocation then reaches it through its 5-minute auth cache).

registry.description: Registry of the bundled Redis image.

repository.description: Repository of the bundled Redis image.

tag.description: Tag of the bundled Redis image: an exact 7.x release.

digest.description: Digest pinned after the tag; wins over the chart's own pin. Empty: the default tag above runs pinned to the digest the chart was tested with (while `image.pinDigests` is on), and any other tag or repository runs by tag.

maxmemory.description: Redis `maxmemory`; keep it below the memory limit.

maxmemoryPolicy.description: Redis `maxmemory-policy`. volatile-lru evicts only keys with a TTL (cache entries), never locks or state.

enabled.description: Keep an append-only file on a volume. Without it a restart drops cache, locks and in-flight state (the app recovers). Install-time only.

size.description: Size of the data volume. Install-time only (see "Install-time settings" in README.md).

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the data volume. Empty: `global.storageClass`, else the cluster default. Install-time only.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the bundled Redis. Empty: the top-level `nodeSelector`.

tolerations.description: Tolerations of the bundled Redis. Empty: the top-level `tolerations`.

affinity.description: Affinity of the bundled Redis. Empty: the top-level `affinity`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod securityContext merged over the chart's (runAsNonRoot, the image's user and group, fsGroup, RuntimeDefault seccomp). `global.compatibility.openshift.adaptSecurityContext` drops the fixed IDs.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext merged over the chart's (no privilege escalation, all capabilities dropped).

mode.description: `external` (a Temporal cluster, e.g. the temporalio/temporal Helm chart) or `bundled` (the single-binary dev server with SQLite on a volume).

namespace.description: [TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE] must exist on an external server (the bundled one creates it).

address.description: [TEMPORAL_HOST] frontend `host:port`, e.g. `temporal-frontend.temporal.svc:7233`. Plain gRPC: TLS and Temporal Cloud API keys are not supported yet.

registry.description: Registry of the bundled Temporal image (the Temporal CLI, `temporal server start-dev`).

repository.description: Repository of the bundled Temporal image.

tag.description: Tag of the bundled Temporal image; the version the Standalone install ships.

digest.description: Optional digest (`sha256:...`) pinned after the tag.

ui.description: Serve the Temporal Web UI on port 8233 of the temporal Service (`kubectl port-forward`).

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the volume. Empty: `global.storageClass`, else the cluster default. Install-time only.

goMemLimit.description: [GOMEMLIMIT] soft memory limit of the server; keep it below the memory limit.

resources.description: Resources of the bundled Temporal server.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the bundled Temporal. Empty: the top-level `nodeSelector`.

tolerations.description: Tolerations of the bundled Temporal. Empty: the top-level `tolerations`.

affinity.description: Affinity of the bundled Temporal. Empty: the top-level `affinity`.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod securityContext merged over the chart's (runAsNonRoot, the image's user and group, fsGroup, RuntimeDefault seccomp). `global.compatibility.openshift.adaptSecurityContext` drops the fixed IDs.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext merged over the chart's (no privilege escalation, all capabilities dropped).

mode.description: `external` (AWS S3, GCS or any S3-compatible service) or `bundled` (one MinIO, for evaluation).

backend.description: [STORAGE_BACKEND] `s3` (AWS), `gcs` (Google Cloud Storage with HMAC keys) or `minio` (any other S3-compatible endpoint). Bundled always uses `minio`.

bucket.description: [UPLOAD_BUCKET_NAME] bucket for uploads, datasets and exports. Created on the first upload (not on GCS) with a public-read policy.

accessKey.description: [S3_ACCESS_KEY, or GCS_HMAC_ACCESS_KEY for gcs]. External: required unless `existingSecret`. Bundled: empty generates one.

secretKey.description: [S3_SECRET_KEY, or GCS_HMAC_SECRET_KEY for gcs]. External: required unless `existingSecret`. Bundled: empty generates one.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret holding the access and secret keys.

existingSecretAccessKeyKey.description: Key of the access key in `existingSecret`.

existingSecretSecretKeyKey.description: Key of the secret key in `existingSecret`.

endpoint.description: [S3_ENDPOINT_URL] e.g. `https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com` or `http://minio.storage:9000`. Empty with `s3` uses s3.amazonaws.com.

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the data volume. Empty: `global.storageClass`, else the cluster default. Install-time only.

resources.description: Resources of the bundled object storage.

replicas.description: Replicas when autoscaling is off. More than one needs the Redis channel layer, which this chart always configures.

preStopSleepSeconds.description: Seconds each API pod sleeps before it stops (preStop), so Services and load balancers stop sending it requests first. 0: none.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds a stopping API pod gets: the preStop sleep, then in-flight requests. Raise it to at least your load balancer's read timeout for long requests.

collectStatic.description: Run collectstatic into an emptyDir before the API starts (static files of /admin and /docs).

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average CPU utilization (percent of requests).

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the API only, as `NAME: value`.

containerSecurityContext.description: Merged over the chart's container security context (read-only root filesystem, no privilege escalation, all capabilities dropped).

tag.description: Tag. Empty: `backend.image.tag`, else `image.tag`, else the chart's appVersion.

gracefulShutdownSeconds.description: [TEMPORAL_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT] seconds a stopping worker lets running activities finish. The pod's grace period is this plus `preStopSleepSeconds` plus 30 s. A `queues` entry can set its own.

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass of every worker pod. Empty: the top-level `priorityClassName`. A `queues` entry can set its own.

enabled.description: One Deployment polling every generic queue (default, tasks_s, tasks_l, tasks_xl, trace_ingestion, agent_compass). This worker also drains the outbox CDC.

excludedQueues.description: [TEMPORAL_EXCLUDED_QUEUES] queues it does not poll. simulation_runner needs the separate simulation-runner image (a `queues` entry with its own image).

excludeDedicatedQueues.description: Also exclude every `queues` entry [TEMPORAL_EXCLUDED_QUEUES], so heavy queues run only on their own Deployments. `false`: the all-queues worker polls them too.

resources.description: Resources of each all-queues worker pod.

enabled.description: HorizontalPodAutoscaler for the all-queues worker.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average CPU utilization (percent of requests).

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average memory utilization (percent of requests). Empty: not used.

enabled.description: A single-slot worker for the exact_aggregation queue, the admission boundary for expensive exact analytics [EXACT_AGGREGATION_TASK_QUEUE=exact_aggregation]. Off: that work runs on tasks_xl.

queues.description: Dedicated per-queue Deployments, added to the all-queues worker (which stops polling them, see `allQueues.excludeDedicatedQueues`), e.g. `[{name: tasks_s, replicas: 2, maxConcurrentActivities: 200}]`; examples/sizes/large.yaml has a full split. Each entry: name (required), replicas, maxConcurrentActivities, maxConcurrentWorkflowTasks, resources, image, extraEnv (wins over `worker.extraEnv` and the chart's own values), autoscaling {enabled, minReplicas, maxReplicas, targetCPUUtilizationPercentage, targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage, behavior} (gaps filled from `allQueues.autoscaling`), gracefulShutdownSeconds, preStopSleepSeconds, pdb {enabled, maxUnavailable}, and nodeSelector, tolerations, affinity, topologySpreadConstraints, priorityClassName, podAnnotations, podLabels (each falling back to the `worker` one).

enabled.description: PodDisruptionBudget for every worker Deployment.

maxUnavailable.description: At most this many pods of each worker Deployment down during voluntary disruptions.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the workers only, as `NAME: value`.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds a stopping collector gets: the preStop sleep, then it flushes its batches to ClickHouse.

type.description: Service type. `LoadBalancer` exposes OTLP/gRPC (4317) outside the cluster; OTLP/HTTP can go through the ingress instead.

annotations.description: Service annotations (e.g. for a cloud load balancer).

repository.description: Repository of the LLM gateway image.

tag.description: Tag. Empty: `image.tag`, else the chart's appVersion.

digest.description: Optional digest (`sha256:...`) pinned after the tag.

preStopSleepSeconds.description: Seconds each gateway pod waits before it stops (preStop, the kubelet's sleep action: Kubernetes 1.30 or newer, skipped on older clusters), so Services stop sending it requests first. 0: none.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds a stopping gateway gets. Keep it at least the preStop sleep + `config.server.shutdown_timeout` (30 s, for in-flight streams) + 5 s (the gateway then sends its buffered request logs): 10 + 30 + 5 = 45. With `config.otel.exporter: otlp`, add up to 15 s for the exporter's last flush.

existingConfigMap.description: Existing ConfigMap with the gateway configuration under the key `config.yaml`. Empty: rendered from `config`.

config.description: Gateway configuration (agentcc-gateway/config.example.yaml documents every field). `${VAR}` expands from the environment: provider keys come from `secrets.llm`. `server.port` is also the container port: the chart pins it with the AGENTCC_PORT variable, which wins over an `existingConfigMap` too.

controlPlaneSync.description: Pull keys and org settings from the backend on start [AGENTCC_CONTROL_PLANE_URL, AGENTCC_SYNC_ON_STARTUP], so every replica and a restarted pod serve the same keys.

allowPrivateProviderURLs.description: Let org providers use base URLs on private networks, such as a local Ollama or vLLM [AGENTCC_ALLOW_PRIVATE_PROVIDER_URLS], for the gateway and the backend. Loopback, link-local and cloud metadata addresses stay refused. Only when everyone who can add a provider is trusted: it puts every in-cluster service in reach of a provider URL. Gateway and backend images from before this setting ignore it and refuse every private URL.

enabled.description: Keep rate limits, budgets and other shared gateway state in the release's Redis [AGENTCC_REDIS_ADDRESS, AGENTCC_REDIS_PASSWORD, AGENTCC_REDIS_DB]. `auto`: on when the gateway runs more than one replica (`replicas` above 1 or autoscaling), off with `redis.external.tls` (the gateway has no Redis TLS): give it a Redis without TLS with AGENTCC_REDIS_ADDRESS in `extraEnv` instead (examples/cloud/aks.yaml). The chart refuses more than one replica without either.

db.description: [AGENTCC_REDIS_DB] Redis database of the gateway, apart from the app's 0-3.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret with a GCP service-account JSON for Vertex AI, mounted read-only [GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS].

type.description: Service type of the gateway. Keep it internal unless your apps call the gateway directly.

goMemLimit.description: [GOMEMLIMIT] soft memory limit; keep it below the memory limit.

enabled.description: HorizontalPodAutoscaler for the gateway.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average CPU utilization (percent of requests).

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average memory utilization (percent of requests). Empty: not used.

behavior.description: HorizontalPodAutoscaler `behavior` (autoscaling/v2), e.g. `{scaleDown: {stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300}}`. Empty: the Kubernetes defaults.

enabled.description: PodDisruptionBudget for the gateway.

maxUnavailable.description: At most this many gateway pods down during voluntary disruptions.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables (AGENTCC_* and provider keys referenced by `config`), as `NAME: value`.

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra `envFrom` sources, e.g. a Secret with more provider keys.

podSecurityContext.description: Merged over the chart's pod security context (non-root uid 65532; the image is a static binary).

containerSecurityContext.description: Merged over the chart's container security context (read-only root filesystem).

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints. Empty: the top-level `topologySpreadConstraints`.

enabled.description: Embedding model server for embedding-based evals, knowledge bases, Vector DB columns and (with an Enterprise Edition license) Error Feed clustering [MODEL_SERVING_URL]. Off: those features are unavailable and the setup screen marks them off.

repository.description: Repository of the model server image.

tag.description: Tag. Empty: `image.tag`, else the chart's appVersion. Append `-gpu` for the CUDA image (linux/amd64).

digest.description: Optional digest (`sha256:...`) pinned after the tag.

resources.description: Resources of each model server pod (add `nvidia.com/gpu` for the GPU image).

enabled.description: Keep downloaded models on a volume (ReadWriteOnce: one replica). Off: an emptyDir, downloaded again after each restart.

storageClass.description: StorageClass of the model cache. Empty: `global.storageClass`, else the cluster default.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables (e.g. TEXT_EMBEDDING_MODEL), as `NAME: value`.

podSecurityContext.description: Merged over the chart's pod security context (non-root uid 1000).

containerSecurityContext.description: Merged over the chart's container security context.

enabled.description: nsjail sandbox for custom code evals. It needs `privileged: true` (Linux namespaces): Pod Security Admission `restricted`/`baseline` namespaces and some managed clusters (GKE Autopilot, Fargate) refuse it.

localFallback.description: [CODE_EXECUTOR_LOCAL_FALLBACK] with the sandbox off (or unreachable), run custom code evals inside the worker pods, next to the platform's secrets (RestrictedPython in a subprocess). `false` (default) refuses them with "Code executor unavailable". Enable only when everyone who can create evals is trusted.

repository.description: Repository of the code sandbox image.

tag.description: Tag. Empty: `image.tag`, else the chart's appVersion.

digest.description: Optional digest (`sha256:...`) pinned after the tag.

allowInternetEgress.description: With `networkPolicy.enabled`: let eval code reach the internet (every private, link-local and metadata range stays blocked). `false` blocks all egress but DNS.

installHook.description: When the job runs on install. `auto`: pre-install when every datastore is external (the app starts on a ready schema), post-install when any is bundled (they must exist first). It always runs pre-upgrade. Argo CD runs a pre-install job in PreSync, a post-install one after the bundled datastores and before the rest of the release.

propertyCatalog.description: Create the observed-attribute index database and its two ClickHouse users (needs CREATE USER and GRANT). `false`: create them yourself.

waitTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for each datastore to accept connections.

clickhouseTimeoutSeconds.description: Deadline of the ClickHouse schema step, in seconds.

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: Deadline of the whole job, in seconds. Keep it below `helm install/upgrade --timeout` (20m in every documented command), so Helm reports how the job ended; raise both together for a long migration.

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: Seconds a finished job (and its logs) is kept. `0`: deleted as soon as it finishes. Empty: kept until the next install or upgrade replaces it.

create.description: Create a dedicated ServiceAccount for the job (it exists before any other resource on install).

name.description: Name of the job's ServiceAccount. Empty: <fullname>-bootstrap when created, else the namespace default.

annotations.description: Annotations, e.g. for cloud IAM database authentication.

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes, e.g. the CA of `postgres.external.sslMode=verify-full`. Empty: `backend.extraVolumes`.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret with the admin's email, name and password (the sign-up rules: 8+ characters, not a common password, not all digits). Empty: create the first account yourself (install notes, step 3).

nameKey.description: Key of the full name in `existingSecret`.

enabled.description: One Ingress for the UI, the API and OTLP/HTTP.

annotations.description: Ingress annotations (e.g. cert-manager, proxy body size and timeouts for uploads and WebSockets).

tls.description: TLS entries, e.g. `[{secretName: futureagi-tls, hosts: [futureagi.example.com, api.futureagi.example.com]}]`. Hosts listed here get https URLs.

host.description: Host of the API. It must differ from the UI host: the API serves many top-level paths.

enabled.description: Route OTLP/HTTP (`/v1/traces`, `/tracer/v1/traces`) to fi-collector.

host.description: Host for OTLP/HTTP. Empty: the API host.

Host of the bundled object storage (`objectStorage.mode=bundled`), for browser downloads [MINIO_URL]. Evaluation only, like the bundled storage itself: it publishes the bucket through the Ingress. Empty: not exposed.

enabled.description: A second Ingress for the API's WebSocket paths (`/ws/`) with its own annotations, so long-lived connections get long timeouts without raising them for every request. Same class, host and TLS as the main one.

annotations.description: Annotations of the WebSocket Ingress, over `ingress.annotations`. ingress-nginx: `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "3600"` and `proxy-send-timeout: "3600"`. Traefik has no per-Ingress timeout: raise the entrypoint's `respondingTimeouts` (examples/ingress-traefik.yaml).

enabled.description: Render HTTPRoutes for the UI and the API (OTLP/HTTP on the exact paths `/v1/traces` and `/tracer/v1/traces` to fi-collector), plus the optional routes below. URLs (`urls.*`) are derived from these hosts unless the ingress is on.

parentRefs.description: Gateways (and listeners) the routes attach to, e.g. `[{name: public, namespace: gateway-system, sectionName: https}]`.

tls.description: The Gateway terminates TLS for these hosts: derived URLs use https. `false`: http.

host.description: Hostname of the API. It must differ from the UI host. Empty: `ingress.api.host`.

enabled.description: Route OTLP/HTTP to fi-collector [FI_COLLECTOR_PUBLIC_URL].

host.description: Hostname for OTLP/HTTP. Empty: the API host.

enabled.description: A GRPCRoute for OTLP/gRPC (the TraceService) to fi-collector's gRPC port. The listener must accept HTTP/2 (HTTPS).

host.description: Hostname for OTLP/gRPC; it must differ from the HTTP route hosts.

enabled.description: An HTTPRoute to the LLM gateway (agentcc-gateway), for applications outside the cluster; every call needs a virtual key. It also opens the gateway in the NetworkPolicies.

host.description: Hostname of the LLM gateway. It must differ from the app and API hosts: each route sends `/` to its own service.

timeout.description: Route timeout (Gateway API duration) of LLM calls; keep it above the gateway's `config.server.write_timeout`. Empty: the Gateway's default.

request.description: Route timeout of API requests (Gateway API duration, e.g. `300s`). Empty: the Gateway's default, often 15 s, which cuts long requests.

websocket.description: Route timeout of the WebSocket paths (`/ws/`). `0s` disables it where the Gateway supports that; some also need a backend or client traffic policy for idle connections (README).

enabled.description: GKE Gateway only: a HealthCheckPolicy (networking.gke.io/v1) for each Service the routes use. GKE's load balancer ignores readiness probes and sends `GET /` with the pod's IP as the Host, which the API (a redirect) and the collector's OTLP port (no `/`) fail; these probe the API's `/health/` with Host `localhost`, the collector's `/healthz` on its admin port 9464, the LLM gateway's `/readyz` and the UI's `/`. Needs the GKE Gateway controller (its CRDs).

NetworkPolicies: the datastores, the gateway, serving and the code sandbox accept traffic only from this release's pods; the UI, API and collector also from `ingressFrom`. A component whose Service is a LoadBalancer or NodePort accepts any source on its Service ports. Egress is open, except for the code sandbox.

ingressFrom.description: Peers (NetworkPolicy `from` entries) that may reach the UI, API and collector, e.g. your ingress controller's namespace: `[{namespaceSelector: {matchLabels: {kubernetes.io/metadata.name: ingress-nginx}}}]`. Empty: any source.

create.description: Create a ServiceAccount for the application pods.

name.description: Name. Empty: <fullname> when created, else the namespace default.

annotations.description: Annotations of the application pods' ServiceAccount. Object storage does not use them: it always authenticates with `objectStorage` keys.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount the ServiceAccount's token in the pods that run as it: the backend, workers, UI, collector, gateway and serving (never the code sandbox). The application does not call the Kubernetes API; turn it on for a sidecar that needs the token (e.g. a Vault agent).

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Default topology spread constraints of the application Deployments. Entries without a `labelSelector` get each component's.

preset.description: Spread of the backend, UI, collector, gateway and worker pods that can run more than one replica and set no `topologySpreadConstraints`: `soft` prefers other zones and nodes, `hard` never puts two replicas on one node while another is free (needs at least two nodes), `none` leaves placement to the scheduler. Bundled datastores are never spread.
